question: Where is the nearest museum you’d find going toward Hall Christmas Tree Farm, Glen Gardner, NJ starting at 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%70 Park Avenue Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hall Christmas Tree Farm%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Glen Gardner%' LIMIT 1 ), bearing_info AS ( SELECT s.geometry AS start_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, d.geometry)) AS target_bearing_deg FROM start_location s, destination_location d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, bearing_info bi WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, bi.start_geom::geography, 200000) -- Search within 200km radius for museums AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the museum's bearing from start and the target bearing LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(bi.start_geom, p.geometry)) - bi.target_bearing_deg), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(bi.start_geom, p.geometry)) - bi.target_bearing_deg) ) <= 45 -- Within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees either side of the target bearing) ) ORDER BY bi.start_geom <-> p.geometry LIMIT 1;
